definitions.dup_unique_key: unique_key already seen earlier (all but the first occurrence)
definitions.exact_duplicate_row: identical to an earlier row in every column (all but the first)
definitions.bad_datetime_format: a non-null date column value does not match the source ISO format or does not parse
definitions.closed_before_created: parsed closed_date is earlier than parsed created_date
definitions.latlon_outside_nyc: non-null latitude or longitude outside the config NYC box (includes swapped pairs)
definitions.latlon_half_missing: exactly one of latitude / longitude is null
definitions.zip_invalid_format: non-null incident_zip that is not exactly 5 digits
definitions.zip_borough_rare_pair: 5-digit ZIP and a borough in config.BOROUGHS whose pair is < 2% of that ZIP's rows (full year)
definitions.complaint_descriptor_rare_pair: (complaint_type, descriptor) pair seen < 5 times in the full year (a null descriptor counts as a value)
definitions.resolution_status_conflict: status is open or closed and its resolution text is seen >= 20 times with >= 95% of its rows in the other status group, or seen < 5 times
definitions.pii_like_free_text: a free-text column holds an e-mail or phone-like number and that exact text occurs < 20 times (frequent templates with public office numbers are kept)
definitions.near_duplicate_candidate: same agency, complaint_type and descriptor (any case), borough and normalised incident_address as an earlier row created <= 300 s before (all but the first)
